caption: 🏃 Lesson of the day: Why not to chase price. Chasing means entering after a big move has already happened, just because you fear missing out. The entry is usually far from any logical stop loss, so the risk grows while the reward shrinks. Example only: if a candle runs a long way up and you jump in at its top, a small pullback can hit your stop quickly. Wait for price to pull back to a level you marked in advance, or skip the trade. Another setup will always come. Educational content, not financial advice. Trading is high risk.
